objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R system that undergoes creation, editing, review, release, distribution, and archiving through a controlled lifecycle.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally defined or business-process-specific regulations and instructions.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type detailing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons for executing tasks within a framework.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures and process sequences to achieve objectives.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object that is released together with its main document and triggers versioning of the main document upon modification.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document object not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not trigger versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting the document version or content history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review a document for continued validity before its expiration date.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and remove it from circulation.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and editing document content.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content for technical and formal correctness.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving and distributing documents to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with permission to view approved documents only.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released content into other languages.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with assigned permissions for reading, authoring, reviewing, releasing, or translating documents.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined format or structure for creating new documents of a specific document type.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document through email notification or acknowledgement workflow.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow-supported confirmation by a user that they have received and read a document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to document their approval or completion of a workflow task.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of all actions, changes, signatures, and workflow events related to a document.

objs.name: version
objs.description: A distinct release of a document with its own status, signature record, and validity period.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A division or department within the company that may be assigned documents or have specific governance requirements.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that can be referenced or linked as relevant to a document.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business or compliance risk that can be linked to and referenced by a document.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with continued read access to archived documents during and after the archiving period.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and custom-defined descriptive properties maintained on documents to enable organization and evaluation.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view displaying documents and workflow tasks relevant to a user.

objs.name: status_report
objs.description: An evaluation report of documents in the system filtered by selected parameters and status.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Core metadata properties of a document such as identifier, type, validity dates, and scope.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach and initialize a new document object with a selected document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using the integrated editing client and office components.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Update metadata, attributes, and categorized properties of a document.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designate a user as the author responsible for a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate a user as a reviewer responsible for checking document content.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate a user as a releaser responsible for approving and distributing a document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to a document during a workflow step to confirm approval or completion.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow to send a document to assigned reviewers for content verification.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check the technical and formal correctness of a document content and properties.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Complete the reviewer step by confirming the document is ready for release.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Return a document during review or release workflow due to identified issues.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by a releaser, making it visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible and accessible to authorized readers in the system.

evts.name: archive_document_content
evts.description: Mark document content for storage and withdrawal of user access rights during lifecycle management.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm a document remains valid and update its expiration date by the standard review period.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document and update its content or properties.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendments to a document without affecting the current version or content history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept a change proposal and incorporate its suggested amendments into a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Mark a change proposal as finished and no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically generate a system request when a document approaches its validity expiration date.

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: Review whether a document should continue, be revised, or be invalidated as part of the validity extension process.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to declare a document invalid and remove it from circulation.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Complete the override workflow to invalidate a document and revoke all user access except archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request to restore a previously invalidated document to active use.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Approve and restore an archived document to valid status with a new version.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users via email that a new document version has been released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Send workflow tasks to assigned users requesting they confirm receipt and understanding of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Complete an acknowledgement workflow task by confirming receipt of a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-specific version of a released document.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the accuracy and completeness of a translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version to authorized readers in that language.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document from its source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Present a document to users in the web interface for viewing and interaction.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Create an evaluation report of documents in the system filtered by role, status, and parameters.

o2o.description: A document may reference or link to other documents, and documents may be related through revision or supersession.
A document may have one or more attachments that are controlled and released with the main document.
A document may have one or more additional information objects that supplement but do not affect the main document version.
A change proposal is associated with and displayed within a single document.
A validity extension request is linked to a specific document for review.
An override request targets a specific document for invalidation.
A reactivation request specifies a document to be restored from archive.
A document may be assigned to or have scope limited to specific organizational units.
A document may reference or be linked to relevant IT applications.
A document may be linked to and address specific business or compliance risks.
A document maintains one or more distribution lists defining which users receive it.
A document consists of one or more versions, each with distinct status and validity.
Users are members of one or more user groups that grant role-based permissions.
An author is a user role with document creation and editing responsibilities.
A reviewer is a user role with document verification responsibilities.
A releaser is a user role with document approval and distribution responsibilities.
A reader is a user role with view-only access to approved documents.
A translator is a user role responsible for creating language versions of documents.
The archive group is a special user group with continued access to archived documents.
A document template is a predefined format that may be selected when creating a new document.
An attachment has its own versioning but is released with and synchronized to the main document version.
An electronic signature is applied by a user to document their approval in a workflow.
An audit trail records all changes, actions, and signatures associated with a document.
Metadata properties are maintained on documents to describe and categorize them.
Master data contains core metadata properties that define a document's identity and scope.
An acknowledgement is a workflow-supported confirmation initiated for specific users.
An acknowledgement workflow is created for a document when distribution for acknowledgement is configured.
A dashboard is generated for a user based on their role and assigned distribution lists.
Status reports evaluate documents in the system with filtering and parameter options.
A policy is a document type containing strategic-level regulations.
A guideline is a document type containing locally defined regulations and instructions.
A work instruction is a document type detailing specific task procedures.
A procedural instruction is a document type describing process sequences and responsibilities.
